claim_text: Netanyahu said, 'Iran targeted one of my sons. Iran tried to kill, to murder one of my sons.'
discovery_sources: Reuters 2026-08-24; Times of Israel Shin Bet follow-up; Israel Hayom/Newsmax follow-up
resolution_notes: Reuters preserves the claim wording from the Channel 14 phone interview. Shin Bet later confirmed a significant threat to Yair Netanyahu and his urgent extraction from Miami, but its public statement did not identify Iran as the source. Separate reporting attributes an Iranian plot to an anonymous U.S. law-enforcement source. Original Channel 14 claim-level media was not recovered in this pass, so the Iranian-attribution component is not resolved and no adverse verdict is forced.
media_status: Original Channel 14 clip/container not recovered; no substitute imagery used.
